correctness.rationale: Proof from the exact circulant Gram inverse, sign-change structure of successive inverse rows, exact integrals of affine crossings, and an absolutely convergent infinite-grid periodization proves all n>=3 statements. The infinite integral simplifies exactly to (9-sqrt(3))/2. Strictness follows from opposed signs of two periodized copies on a positive-length interval. Tail integrability gives an O((2-sqrt3)^(n/2)) deficit. Finite rational calculations are corroboration, not a substitute.
